summary: Recording broker/gRPC acknowledgement contract for planned backbone protocol transport bundles.
claim_boundary: Recording executor contract only. This slice converts planned AsyncAPI broker publish and proto/gRPC unary descriptors into deterministic acknowledgement reports for integration tests. It does not connect to a live broker, start a gRPC server, serialize protobuf payloads, perform retries, run an async runtime, or claim production delivery guarantees.

facets.F1_simplicity: The acknowledgement seam extends the existing transport kernel instead of adding a broker SDK or async runtime dependency.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Transport plans now have deterministic acknowledgement reports carrying tenant, audit, policy, idempotency, broker, and gRPC metadata before live broker/server integration.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests cover successful ack recording, deterministic sequence refs, tenant-scope drift between broker and gRPC descriptors, and idempotency drift refusal.
facets.F5_quality: Focused transport tests plus broad 34-package backbone cargo check/test/clippy/fmt, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Acknowledgement reports carry routing and audit metadata only; no payload bodies, credentials, or raw personal content are recorded.
facets.F11_observability: Ack refs and execution reports provide deterministic audit/debug evidence for future runtime adapters, while live broker/gRPC telemetry remains pending.
